{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
meta_file=temp_workspace/matrix_metadata.txt
if [ -e /root/matrix.txt ]; then
  size=$(stat -c%s /root/matrix.txt)
  perms=$(stat -c%A /root/matrix.txt)
  exist=yes
else
  size=0
  perms=-
  exist=no
fi
printf 'exists: %s\nsize: %s\npermissions: %s\n' "$exist" "$size" "$perms" > "$meta_file"

sanitized=temp_workspace/matrix_sanitized.txt
if [ -e /root/matrix.txt ]; then
  perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n/\n/g; s/\r/\n/g; s/\x00+$//' /root/matrix.txt > "$sanitized"
else
  : > "$sanitized"
fi

head -n 10 "$sanitized" > temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt

cat > temp_workspace/compute_line_count <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
file="$(dirname "$0")/matrix_sanitized.txt"
if [ -e "$file" ]; then
  awk 'END{print NR}' "$file" > /root/matrix_linecount.txt
else
  echo 0 > /root/matrix_linecount.txt
fi
EOF
chmod +x temp_workspace/compute_line_count

if [ -e /root/matrix.txt ]; then
  awk 'END{print NR}' /root/matrix.txt
else
  echo 0
fi
"}
